definition: to be ready to support a person
description: At a harbour at dusk in the rain, under a green wooden shelter with a corrugated roof and a glowing lamp, a young woman in a burgundy jumper and wide black trousers leans over and pulls a navy rain jacket over the head of a young man in a white T-shirt who sits on a bench looking down. She settles the jacket round his shoulders, he looks up and smiles at her, and she rests her head against his. A broken umbrella lies inside out on the wet ground, and a black dog sits beside him.
